title: Jim Queen (FCP 2026)
synopsis: On the Parisian gay scene, Jim is the king of Gym Queens, the sexiest and most coveted community on social media. One day, he realises he’s been infected with Heterosis, a strange virus decimating the community and turning gay men into... heterosexuals!

synopsis_lang.en: On the Parisian gay scene, Jim is the king of Gym Queens, the sexiest and most coveted community on social media. One day, he realises he’s been infected with Heterosis, a strange virus decimating the community and turning gay men into... heterosexuals!
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 在巴黎同志圈，Jim 被譽為是「Gym Queens」——社交媒體上最性感、最令人垂涎的一個群體中的王者。某天，他發現自己感染了「異性戀症」(Heterosis)——一種正重創這個圈子的怪異病毒，它會把男同志變成......異性戀!
